method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: S&P 500 Closes Flat as Bank Earnings Kick Off, Chipmakers Slide
Equities.reason: Market-wide note: mixed bank earnings and semiconductor weakness point to neutral-to-deteriorating risk sentiment. Broad-market implication (S&P/tech leadership) makes this moderately relevant and mildly negative for equities.

Equities.title: Nasdaq ends down as chipmakers fall and bank earnings roll in
Equities.reason: Reinforces tech/chip-led drag and cautious reaction to bank earnings — negative for growth/AI leadership in near term; good relevance as it underscores the prevailing intraday market impulse.

Equities.title: ASML says it's getting order interest through 2030 as profit smashes expectations
Equities.summary: ASML said some customers are "expressing an interest" in placing orders with the company in 2029 and 2030, giving investors a view into longer-term demand.
Equities.reason: Firm-level/sector-leading data pointing to durable semiconductor/AI capex demand — positive for tech/AI leadership narrative and market regime; fairly high relevance given ASML's market signaling role.

Equities.title: Failure of Australia’s Largest IPO in Decades Sends Tremors Through AI Trade
Equities.reason: Idiosyncratic but high-signal event for the AI/IPO theme — failure undermines investor appetite for AI-paper and weighs on risk sentiment in that style/sector.

Equities.title: Bank of America fined $1.2 billion over money-laundering violations
Equities.summary: The action by the Treasury Department was announced less than a day before Bank of America reports quarterly earnings.
Equities.reason: Significant negative news for a major bank arriving into earnings season — increases downside risk for financial sector and contributes to broader market caution.

Equities.title: Rosenberg Warns of Most Stretched Market in His 40-Year Career
Equities.reason: Strong macro/market-structure warning from a prominent strategist signals elevated downside risk and vulnerability in the current regime — high relevance to market sentiment and positioning.

Equities.title: Citadel Securities’ Rubner Says Retail Traders Return to AI Bets
Equities.reason: Indicates renewed retail appetite for AI names, supporting risk-on flows into the AI leadership theme; smaller relevance than institutional signals but a positive contributor to momentum.

Equities.title: TRADING DAY Earnings season debuts to mixed reviews
Equities.reason: Broad commentary that earnings are mixed and markets are unexcited — modest negative tilt for near-term equity sentiment and positioning during earnings season.

Rates.title: U.S. Treasury yields inch lower as investors await key inflation report
Rates.summary: U.S. Treasury yields inched lower on Wednesday as investors awaited the latest CPI inflation reading ahead of a flurry of economic data this week.
Rates.reason: Direct report that Treasury yields are moving lower ahead of US CPI — clear bond-rally signal. High relevance given direct focus on US rates and imminent CPI data that drives front-end and term-structure moves.

Rates.title: Williams says Fed may not have to hike rates in 2027, at odds with traders
Rates.summary: New York Fed President John Williams sees one more rate hike in 2026 but no additional increase in 2027 as inflation pressures ease.
Rates.reason: Top Fed official signalling fewer future hikes is dovish for rates — pushes market expectations of lower terminal rates and supports Treasury demand. Important Fed-speak with material implications for yields and policy path.

Rates.title: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, September 15-16, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, September 15-16, 2026
Rates.reason: FOMC minutes are a primary input to market rate expectations. With contemporaneous market moves leaning dovish (see Williams, yields inching lower), interpret minutes as modestly supportive of lower-for-longer expectations — moderate relevance.

Rates.title: Minutes of the Board's discount rate meetings on August 17, September 9, and September 16, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Board's discount rate meetings on August 17, September 9, and September 16, 2026
Rates.reason: Operational/administrative minutes with lower immediate market impact than FOMC minutes; small positive tilt given broader dovish signals but limited direct rate-market transmission — low relevance.

Rates.title: Hong Kong’s Low Aggregate Balance Sparks Rate Volatility Concern
Rates.reason: Low aggregate balance in Hong Kong increases potential for rate/liqidity volatility in local money markets; risk of sudden repo/short-term rate spikes is negative for fixed income stability — material regional rates risk.

Rates.title: KKR Sees Bond Rout as Opening to Lock in High-Grade Asian Credit
Rates.reason: Headline framing of a 'bond rout' implies continued supply/valuation stress and higher yields in Asian credit markets — negative for bond prices and indicates widening risk premium in the region.

Rates.title: Bassman Warns of ‘Nightmare Scenario’ Amplifying US Bond Selloff
Rates.reason: Explicit warning of an amplifying US bond selloff is a high-signal negative for rates (higher yields / bond-price pressure). Elevated relevance due to potential systemic amplification of selloff risks.

Rates.title: New Zealand Dollar drifts higher above 0.5600, all eyes on US CPI inflation data
Rates.summary: The NZD/USD pair rebounds from a 17-month low to near 0.5625 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday. The US dollar (USD) weakens against the New Zealand Dollar (NZD) amid easing US bond yields and dovish signals from New York Federal Reserve (Fed
Rates.reason: FX piece cites easing US bond yields and dovish Fed signals as the driver for USD weakness — consistent with bond rally narrative. Included at lower relevance because primary article is FX-focused but contains explicit rates transmission.

Rates.title: Breaking: China’s CPI inflation rises to 0.9% YoY in September, vs. 1.0% expected
Rates.summary: China’s Consumer Price Index (CPI) climbed 0.9% in September from a year ago after arriving at a rise of 0.8% in August, the National Bureau of Statistics of China reported on Wednesday. The market consensus was for 1.0% in the reported period.
Rates.reason: Slightly softer-than-expected China CPI reduces local inflation pressure and can ease regional rate-hike expectations and term premia — modestly positive for local bond markets and Asian rates more broadly.

Rates.title: BoE’s Pill says a bit more sceptical about market pricing of four rate hikes over the next year
Rates.summary: Bank of England (BoE) Chief Economist Huw Pill said on Wednesday that he is a bit more sceptical about market pricing of four rate hikes over the next year. Pill added that UK output and labor market have proven more resilient.
Rates.reason: Commentary from a senior BoE official that questions aggressive market-implied tightening is read as mildly dovish for UK rates, but the message is somewhat ambiguous and FX-focused — therefore low relevance and near-neutral impact.

FX.title: Lagarde speech: We're not seeing any second round effects yet
FX.summary: European Central Bank (ECB) President Christine Lagarde said on Wednesday that inflation has been rising predominantly but not exclusively as a result of energy prices. Lagarde added that she’s not seeing any second round effects yet.
FX.reason: ECB President saying inflation is mainly energy-driven and no second-round effects reduces near-term ECB hawkishness — bearish for EUR vs USD (EUR downside / USD upside). Material for EUR/USD and EUR positioning.

FX.title: Swiss Franc strengthens as US Dollar slips on dovish Fed signals
FX.summary: USD/CHF extends its losses for the second consecutive day, trading around 0.8320 during Asian hours on Wednesday. The currency pair depreciated as the US Dollar (USD) lost ground following dovish remarks from New York Federal Reserve President John Williams.
FX.reason: Dovish Fed commentary driving broad USD weakness and CHF/major crosses higher. This is a USD-centric move (USD down), relevant for major pairs and cross-asset flows.

FX.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Hits one-week top as bulls eye range breakout above 1.3300
FX.summary: The GBP/USD pair attracts some follow-through buying for the second straight day, advancing to a one-week high during the Asian session on Wednesday amid the ongoing US Dollar (USD) corrective slide.
FX.reason: Technical/price-forecast piece showing GBP strength against a corrective USD slide. Tactical note only (technical relevance capped).

FX.title: Euro: Rebound tests key resistance band against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: United Overseas Bank’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann highlight a strong EUR/USD rebound to around 1.1200 after recent oversold weakness.
FX.reason: Bank research noting EUR/USD technical rebound. Relevant to EUR/USD moves but primarily a technical/resistance test — relevance limited accordingly.

FX.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Hovers around 1.4200 after breaking below nine-day EMA
FX.summary: USD/CAD loses ground for the second successive day, trading around 1.4200 during Asian hours on Wednesday. The technical analysis of the daily chart indicates that the price is remaining within the ascending channel pattern, suggesting an ongoing bullish bias.
FX.reason: USD/CAD technical note showing CAD strength / USD weakness. Technical focus limits relevance, but it feeds into USD-basket flow for commodity-linked CAD.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar clings to gains near 0.5620 vs USD after China's inflation data
FX.summary: The NZD/USD pair gains some positive traction for the second day on Wednesday, building on the overnight bounce from the 0.5580 support zone, or the lowest level since April 2025.
FX.reason: NZD/USD strength following China inflation prints — supports risk/commodity-linked FX and points to incremental USD softness. Smaller EM/antipodean relevance versus majors.

FX.title: Indian Rupee: RBI FX steps support INR but raise hedging costs – MUFG
FX.summary: MUFG’s Michael Wan explains that recent RBI FX measures have supported spot Indian Rupee, while temporarily disrupting derivatives liquidity. Offshore INR forward premiums fell sharply after restrictions on non-resident NDF access and higher hedge costs. These
FX.reason: RBI intervention/FX measures have direct transmission to INR spot and forward markets (supporting INR but raising hedging costs). High EMFX relevance and impacts USD/INR positioning and offshore premium dynamics.

FX.title: Russia pounds Ukraine's energy infrastructure, leaving 600,000 without power
FX.summary: A ballistic missile has struck energy infrastructure supposedly covered by the "energy ceasefire" announced by Trump on Sunday, Zelenskyy said.
FX.reason: Escalation and strikes on energy infrastructure are risk-off drivers that typically bid safe-havens (USD, JPY) and weigh on risk-sensitive FX. Significant geopolitical shock with clear FX transmission into USD strength / EM and commodity-linked FX weakness.

FX.title: British Pound gains as UK assures fiscal discipline
FX.summary: The British Pound (GBP) trades higher against its major currency peers, except antipodeans, on Wednesday. In the early European trade, the British currency is up 0.2% at around 210.12 against the Japanese Yen (JPY).
FX.reason: UK fiscal-discipline signals support GBP across major pairs (including vs USD). Fundamental domestic fiscal news has direct FX transmission and reinforces GBP strength narrative.

Commodities.title: Gold struggles around $4,150 as Fed hike bets counter USD weakness ahead of US CPI report
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) trades with a negative bias for the third straight day, hovering below $4,150 heading into Wednesday’s European session as focus remains on the latest US inflation figures.
Commodities.reason: Gold sitting below $4,150 ahead of US CPI reflects rate-sensitivity: Fed hike bets are a headwind (negative), while USD moves provide some offset. High relevance because US CPI is a near-term driver for precious metals.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD declines to near $58.70 in countdown to US inflation data
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) is down 0.65% to near $58.70 during the European trading session on Wednesday. The white metal is under pressure as oil prices have increased recently amid ongoing tensions in the Middle East.
Commodities.reason: Near-term technical/price-forecast piece: small downside as silver reacts to broader risk/oil moves and pre-CPI positioning. Price-forecast articles get limited relevance.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD remains above $59.00 amid dovish Fed remarks
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) gains ground after two days of losses, trading around $59.20 per troy ounce during Asian hours on Wednesday. Non-yielding Silver gains following dovish remarks from New York Federal Reserve President John Williams.
Commodities.reason: Dovish Fed commentary supports non-yielding metals like silver. Article is price-forecast/tactical in nature so relevance is capped below full macro pieces.

Commodities.title: Gold prices hold firm ahead of US inflation data
Commodities.reason: Reuters note that gold is holding ahead of US CPI implies underlying buy-side support into the data. Relevant for near-term precious metals positioning.

Commodities.title: Mixed outlook for energy expenditures this winter
Commodities.summary: We expect energy expenditures this winter to vary because of diverging trends in energy prices among fuels and regional variation in forecast temperatures. We expect that lower prices for natural gas and propane will drive decreases in expenditures this year f
Commodities.reason: EIA outlook flags lower natural gas and propane prices (negative for those commodities). It's a fundamental supply/demand/price signal for the energy complex with direct commodity relevance.

Commodities.title: Category 2 Hurricane Isaias nears landfall, leading to production shut-ins
Commodities.summary: As of 4:00 a.m. central time on October 9, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration expects Hurricane Isaias to make landfall on the Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday, creating the potential for significant disruptions to energy infrastructur
Commodities.reason: Imminent production shut-ins from a Gulf hurricane are a clear supply-side shock for oil/gas. High relevance given potential for immediate disruption to flows and inventories.

Commodities.title: Crude oil prices and refinery margins generally increased throughout the third quarter
Commodities.summary: Petroleum markets in the third quarter of 2026 (3Q26) were characterized by increasing prices for crude oil and petroleum products amid persistent conflict in the Middle East.
Commodities.reason: EIA Q3 recap documents rising crude and refinery margins tied to Middle East conflict — a meaningful, persistent bull signal for oil markets and refining economics.

Commodities.title: China’s exports surge 36% as AI-related shipments boom
Commodities.summary: Imports soar by a third as high oil prices from Middle East conflict push up energy bill
Commodities.reason: FT notes that high oil prices (linked to Middle East conflict) are boosting China's energy bill — supports the broader oil price narrative via higher global energy costs and demand for shipments.

Commodities.title: World’s Top Copper Mine Faces Strike as Wage Talks Break Down
Commodities.reason: Strike risk at a top copper mine implies a material supply disruption for copper — a clear positive price impulse with significant market relevance for industrial metals.

Commodities.title: Oil Rises as Middle East Attacks Increase Uncertainty Over Flows
Commodities.reason: Headline directly links escalating Middle East attacks to supply-flow uncertainty — a constructive near-term driver for crude prices with above-average relevance.

Crypto.reason: BTC price action tied to major US inflation release — near-term volatility/flow driver for crypto markets, but neutral-to-slightly constructive as rangebound trading reduces immediate downside risk.

Crypto.reason: Judicial outcome that strengthens government claim on seized crypto raises policy and confiscation risk for holders and could weigh on sentiment toward on-chain asset protection.

Crypto.title: Tom Lee sees $2 trillion wealth transfer fueling crypto demand as Bitmine buys more ether
Crypto.reason: Macro narrative of large wealth transfer into crypto alongside miner/institutional purchases of ETH supports medium-term demand thesis — constructive for asset-class flows.

Crypto.title: UK crypto trader says almost $800,000 lost in knife assault as wrench attacks proliferate
Crypto.reason: Increasing reports of physical extortion against crypto holders highlight safety risks that can deter retail participation and raise reputational/security concerns.
